about: src/lib/scale_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-units scale_qty, the recipe editors' copy to another size). src/features/menu/recipe/grid-model.test.ts runs the dashboard's wrappers (the wasm) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
